# Development package

`cazala-automata-0.0.0-development.tgz` is built with `npm pack` from
Automata PR [#9](https://github.com/cazala/automata/pull/9), commit `f08f7de`.
It keeps the Growing Neural CA demo reproducible until that API is released.

Replace the file dependency with the released `@cazala/automata` version and
remove this directory after the Automata release.
